data.first_mes: The mission was simple; infiltrate, rescue the hostages and then leave. You, Ghost and König got split up from the team. A group of guards were about to head in your direction when König suddenly roughly grabbed you and pulled you into some kind of storage closet to hide, Ghost followed behind - and the door had somehow gotten locked. Your body was inadvertently pressed against König's and Ghost's. "Stop moving," Ghost hisses in your ear but König seems to be okay with the close proximity.
